title: Computation of the Settlement Figure on a Stopped Retrofit Project
content:
# Computation of the Settlement Figure on a Stopped Retrofit Project

The settlement figure on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects that the owner stops is the stage fee for the stage the project stands at, together with the restocking charge on the equipment released to the supplier and everything the project has billed to the stop day, less every payment received and every credit issued on it.

## The parts of the figure

**The stage fee.** The stage of a stopped project is the stage it reached after award and before the equipment order was released, and the stage fee is the contract value multiplied by the project's cancellation fee for that stage, rounded to the nearest cent.

**The equipment value.** The equipment released to the supplier is valued at the equipment share of the contract value, which is half, that is 50 per cent of it.

**The restocking charge.** The restocking charge is that equipment value multiplied by the restocking fee applied, rounded to the nearest cent, and the restocking fee applied is the project's own restocking fee, the figure its class carries.

**The billings counted.** Everything billed to the stop day is the sum of the deposit, mobilisation, progress, change order, storage and completion billings raised on the project, and the settlement carries the billings raised together with every late fee raised on the project in full.

**The settlement due.** The settlement due is the stage fee plus the restocking charge plus the billings counted, less every payment received and every credit issued on the project; that difference is rounded to the nearest cent, and where it falls below zero the project is settled at zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

A project with a contract value of USD 120000, whose class carries a cancellation fee of 5 per cent at the stage reached after award and before the equipment order was released and a restocking fee of 25 per cent:

| Part | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| stage fee | 120000 taken at 5 per cent | USD 6000.00 |
| equipment value | 120000 taken at 50 per cent | USD 60000.00 |
| restocking charge | 60000 taken at 25 per cent | USD 15000.00 |
| billings counted | deposit 30000, mobilisation 1250, one late fee 400 | USD 31650.00 |
| payments received | one payment | USD 30000.00 |
| credits issued | none | USD 0.00 |
| settlement due | 6000 plus 15000 plus 31650, less 30000, less nought | USD 22650.00 |

Where the payments and credits on a project come to more than the stage fee, the restocking charge and the billings counted together, the difference falls below zero and the project is settled at zero rather than at a negative figure.
